give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
```sql

```sql
SELECT
  district,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_point_increase
FROM anc_visits
WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
  AND year IN (2021, 2023)
GROUP BY district;
